metadata.name: EZPZ Rubber Duck
metadata.description: Squeeze, drag and release a 3D rubber duck on rippling water. Editable React and Three.js component with configurable color, optional synthesized squeak, keyboard interaction and reduced-motion support. No visible controls. Duck mesh adapted from Sony Computer Entertainment’s SCEA Duck via Khronos under the SCEA Shared Source License 1.0. Full asset license and modification notes retained in source. Complete editable project: https://github.com/ezam0000/ezpz-rubber-duck. Application code MIT licensed.
